balls.text: makes room to slog but misses, the ball just sails over the middle stump, de Villiers whips off the bails but Saha's foot was back at the crease
steps down the track and tries to clear long-on but he mishits it, fortunately for him it lands short of the fielder
bowls the quicker one and gets it to kick up on him, Abdullah glides it down to third man and settles for a single only
excellent yorker, fires that on the offstump and there wasn't much Abdulla could do about that
bowls a yorker on the pads and he shuffles and whips it to deep square leg
pitches it up on middle and off, Hussey makes room for the loft but doesn't quite get under it, he ends up spooning it down Tiwary's throat just over midwicket
fires in another yorker, Hussey can only dig it out to point
that's a mishit over mid-off and Saha gets away with it, he doesn't time it well at all
full outside off, he pushes it towards cover
he pays the price for bowling a dolly of a full toss, he goes back, then comes forward and bludgeons it over deep square leg, that's his 17th six-  the highest so far by any batsman in the IPL
full outside off, he pushes it to long-off
fires it in the blockhole, he fails to dig it out

lovely catch at the deep! Shukla gets on his knee and tries to slog it over midwicket just like Hussey did two balls earlier, the elevation was missing and Gambhir runs across from deep square leg and catches it after diving forward
low full toss, he makes room and mows it behind square on the on side
shot! That was pitched up on middle and leg and in the slot to loft, Hussey carts it high over deep midwicket, that's a welcome six
gets across and whips it to deep midwicket
waits for it at the crease and lofts it over mid-on, can't find the boundary
fullish outside off, he pushes it down to long-off

interesting! McGrath fields off his own bowling and sees Shukla scamper back to his crease, he decides not to run him out and then sees Hussey out of his crease as well, he decides against running him out as well and they share a laugh after that
moves across his stumps early and paddles it on the full straight to short fine leg, there was a boundary opportunity there
walks down the pitch, he meets the ball on a yorker length and squeezes it behind the wicket
lovely delivery, lands that hard on the blockhole and he only just manages to dig it out to the on side
makes plenty of room and carves a full delivery over the infield, it goes on the first bounce to sweeper cover
pitches outside off and gets it to nip back in, he shuffles and tucks it to square leg
comes round the wicket and bowls the slower ball, he stretches out and gets an outside edge down towards third man
that was a real gift for Shukla, he gets a full toss and width to flay his arms and he smashes that just wide of extra cover

he angles it down to Dilshan at third man again, Taibu takes the risk with the second run and makes a dive for the crease fairly early, the throw lands just above the stumps and de Villiers whips off the bails, the third umpire Jayaprakash has a look and gives it out
hits a good length outside off, he angles it down to third man
holds the length back but sticks to the line outside off, he places it to point this time
backs away from the stumps and crashes that towards the covers, he can't find the gap
steps down the track to crash that past the infield but places it straight to Sehwag at extra cover
slides on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
cuts back on the pace, he tries to mow it across the line but gets beaten
bowls the flipper, he puts it away to sweeper cover
plays the conventional sweep, McGrath picks it up at deep square leg
plays a premeditated reverse sweep but ends up playing it straight to backward point
makes room and attempts a wild slash past backward point but misses it completely, he shows his frustrations
gets across and whips it behind square on the on side
excellent running! He taps it in front of cover and sets off fast, Taibu is even quicker and makes it back home well in time
Taibu shuffles across and tucks it wide of square leg
fullish outside off, he gets behind the line and pushes this one to long-off
poor shot, Yomahesh dishes it out full and wide outside off, Butt makes room to slice that over third man but he ends up placing it straight to McGrath at third man
starts off his new spell with a wide outside off
steps down the track but checks his stroke, he settles for a single to long-off
stays back at the crease and glides it down to third man, the ball skids through a little low but he adjusts well
gets forward and pushes it to the offside
flighted outside off, he pushes to long-off
the googly, he gets on his knee to sweep but the ball trickles of his pads, he appeals but the ball hit him outside the line of ofstump
flighted outside off, he stays back at the crease, waits for the turn and delicately glides it wide of short third man
makes room to beat the infield but the ball is too full for the loft and he settles for a single to long-off
flighted on middle and leg, he gets forward and taps it to long-on
gets forward and pushes this towards the covers
slides down the legside, he gets on his knee early and slams it wide of deep square leg
slides down the legside, the ball deflects off the pads
chance there! Almost... He bowls the flipper this time and it appeared like it took the thin edge, de Villiers juggles the ball and fumbles
foxes him completely with a googly, Hussey goes for the offdrive and gets beaten, that wasn't far from the edge and the offstump
shuffles at the crease and whips it to midwicket
leans forward and pushes this through the line to long-off
sweeps a little too early and the ball trickles off his pads to the offside, Hussey calls for the run quickly
lands on offstump line and comes on straight, he taps it back to the bowler
gets forward and taps it to the offside, Kolkata are going at 7 an over, almost
slides down the leg side, he tries to glance but misses
taps it down hard to short cover and a sliding stop by Dilshan saves a couple of runs
the slower ball, lands on a good length outside off, he swivels and pulls it down to deep square leg,there;s protection on the on side
hits a good length on off stump, he covers the line and pushes it wide of mid-off
gets across and taps it down to backward point
cuts back on the pace and lands it on a full length, he comes forward and pushes it down to extra cover
that should make Butt feel a lot better, Yomahesh bowls it quick and once again strays too wide outside off, he plays it harder and sends it scorching past cover this time
he bowls the slower ball but misdirects it too wide outside off, Butt reads it early and creams it on the frontfoot past extra cover
puts it more effort and thuds it on the pitch, Butt hops and defends it back to the bowler
bowls that short and wide outside the offstump, he gets back and across and slams it to deep cover
full and just a touch wide outside, he pushes it through the line to long-off, another single
hits a good length outside off, he gets behind the line and defends to the offside
nips back in from offstump, he tucks it off his hips and declines the single
hits a good length outside off, he leans forward and taps it wide of cover
bowls the offcutter, he slides down the legside and he paddles it down to fine leg
the slower ball, he gets forward and pushes it down to long-off
turns his bat just before the point of contact and tucks it wide of mid-on, Butt's not slamming them around here
full and wide outside the offstump and he pushes it firmly to long-off
pitches outside the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man
timber! Yomahesh pitches that on a good length on legstump and the ball holds its line, Ganguly makes room to pull but swings his bat too early, the ball clips the thigh and hits the top of legstump
loses his line again and he strays wide down the legside, he's struggling
strays a little too wide outside the offstump, Ganguly just lets it go
pitches around the offstump, he angles it behind point
pitches it outside the offstump and he angles it down to third man
Free Hit: The crowd asked for it and they got it.... Yomahesh overpitches outside the offstump, Ganguly stays put at the crease, makes room and carves it over the bowler's head
oversteps, pitches on middle and holds its line, he covers the line and defends
walks across to meet the pitch of the ball and pushes a full ball down to long-off to get off strike
very soft dismissal, lands on a good length on the offstump and Chopra shapes to loft through the line, the elevation is missing and he ends up scooping it straight to Maharoof at mid-off
walks down the track early to unsettle the bowler but he ends up placing it straight to mid-on
gets across his stumps and turns it to the region of mid-on, they take a quick single and Butt makes his ground before the throw at his end takes out the offstump
gets away with a full delivery on the pads as Butt whips it straight to midwicket
strives for that extra yard of pace and sprays it too wide outside off
the short of a length delivery sits up nicely for Butt who plays a swivel pull and beats midwicket by a big margin
brings the line closer to the offstump, he gets across and flicks it to mid-on
slides wide outside off, too wide for him to chase that
wrong line, he sprays it on the pads and the ball is pitched up, enough for him to get across and whip it high over square leg and beat the fielder in the deep
Chopra taps it softly in front of point and sets off, Butt wisely sends him back on seeing Tiwary make a dash for the ball and try to underarm it to the stumps
tucks it away and times it very crisply but again he fails to get the placement right and places it straight to square leg
gets forward and times it fairly crisply but fails to beat the gap between mid-off and cover
good line and length, cramps him for room outside off, Butt gets forward and defends softly
gets forward to the pitch of the ball early and pushes it just in front of mid-off and calls for the run quickly
uppish but safe, the ball kicks up on a good length outside off, he reaches out and carves it over backward point, it was there to be hit
the quicker one this time, he shuffles and tucks it across the line towards mid-on
foxes him with the slower ball, he leans forward but gets beaten
keeps him quiet again as he tucks it to the on side and finds the square leg fielder
slides just a bit wide outside the offstump and Chopra watchfully lets it go
angles in from around the offstump, he gets across and taps it to the onside
slides just a bit on the pads and holds its line, the ball clips the pad as he attempts to glance it down to fine leg
hits a good length on middle and leg, he taps it back to the bowler
fullish outside the offstump, he gets forward and pushes it to the offside
Dropped: Chopra fishes outside the offstump and the edge carries wide of the keeper, Gambhir is too wide at first slip and fumbles despite getting both hands behind the ball
chops it just wide of backward point and Tiwary does well to slide to his right and cut it off
superb placement! McGrath pitches it fractionally wide outside the offstump, Butt gets back and across and slices perfectly in the arc between cover and backward point
this one comes back in towards the right hander and he whips it off his pads wide of midwicket to retain the strike
kicks up off a good length and he moves across his stumps and dabs it away very late down to third man
loses his line and sprays it wide outside the legstump
that was a textbook manual cover drive, Sangwan grants him plenty of width and Chopra is quick to the task, gets to the pitch and times it well past the covers
another quick delivery but he makes him play this time as he tucks it close to the pads on the on side
bangs in the bouncer and he decides to withdraw the stroke as he sees the ball suddenly dipping
pitches on offstump and holds its line. he covers the line well and defends back to him
pitches on middle and leg, he closes the face of the bat and nudges it behind square on the on side, quiet start for Kolkata
ambles in and bowls that fairly slowly, Butt is circumspect and chooses to let it go
hits a good length outside the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
bowls the half volley outside off and a crisp drive is well intercepted by the local boy Tiwary
draws him forward with a full delivery, he taps it towards point and turns down the single
slides on the pads, the ball comes on straight and he tucks it off his pads for a legbye to the on side

hits the timber and it's all over! Yomahesh walks across his stumps to paddle it fine but the ball is too straight and full, it flattens his middle stump and Shukla picks up three in this magical over
whoopsy! In the excitement he loses control of the swing and sprays it wide down leg, it's too quick for Saha to intercept it
fires it on the blockhole outside off, he makes a bit of room to squeeze it out but he misses
On a hat-trick here! Sangwan stays at the crease and tries to go downtown, he picks a pitched up delivery outside off and fails to get the elevation, Hussey takes the sitter at long-on

Mishra tries to get too cheeky by walking across his stumps and dragging it from way outside off, the paddle scoop really travels off his blade but Ishant's position at short fine leg  is perfect for the catch
bowls it full and wide outside the offstump and he places it straight to extra cover
makes room to play a delicate glide down to third man but he's beaten for pace
another direct hit! He pushes it to the covers and sets off for a riskly run, there's a direct hit at the non-striker's end but he was safe
this one kicks up off a good length and nearly takes the edge, the whole of Kolkata thought it was out
holds the length back as he slides on middle and leg, he turns it to fine leg
full on middle and leg again and he pushes it towards long-on
gets forward to a full delivery and pushes towards mid-on

very untimely run-out! The short delivery catches Maharoof by surprise and he fails to control the pull, the ball trickles off his gloves and Mishra sets off, Maharoof was ball watching however as Dinda ran forward, picked it up and hits the stump, the third umpire takes a look, Shah Rukh is out of his seat again
he angles it off the meat of the bat behind backward point and they take it too easy on the first run, there should have been two there
backs away a little from the stumps and square drives it towards third man
angles in towards the legstump and he glides it down to fine leg
charges down the track and he misses the slice completely, the length was a little too short for that stroke and it nearly shaves the offstump
Dinda makes him think as he gets one to nip back in and skid through, he gets a thick outside edge to third man
gets a half stride forward and times a full delivery crisply past the bowler and down to long-on
rocks back just a touch and punches it softly through the line to long-on
holds the length back, he rocks back and punches it nicely off the backfoot to long-off
he lands it too full and that allows another easy single to long-off this time, Ganguly needs to nip one back in
gets a good strode forward and plays a neat cover drive, Butt runs across and intercepts it
hits a good length outside off, he leans forward and taps it wide of point
leans forward and drives past the bowler almost one handed
that should ease the pressure a bit, he slides down the legside and he gets a thin edge on the glance and glides it past the keeper and down to fine leg
makes just a half stride forward, he accounts for the flight and merely scoops it through the line over extra cover, well controlled in the end
a loopy full toss, he makes contact off the toe end of the bat and takes a single to long-off
gets forward and pushes to extra cover
slides on the pads, he gets on his knee and sweeps past square leg, Butt picks it up

: Will Kolkata regret that? Maharoof punches it back hard but just checks his stroke at the last moment, ganguly turns in his follow through, gets his hands underneath it but ends up grabbing it, he's flat on the turf frustrated with himself
full outside off, he pushes it through the line to long-off
he makes room for himself and scoops it over extra cover, it was the wrong length by Ganguly and was duly punished
gets forward and pushes this one down to long-off
complete confusion in the running, he tucks it to the on side and Maharoof is sent back as they attempt a risky second run
steps down the track, sees the width and adjusts his stroke to a delicate late cut, Ganguly reckons he could have had him had there been a slip
stays at the crease and tucks it away past midwicket
tossed up outside off, chips it to long-off
takes a few paces down the track and chips it uppishly past the bowler and down to long-off
gets forward to smother the turn and he turns it wide of midwicket
flighted on middle and leg, he rocks back and pushes it to long-on

There's a raucous din at Eden at the moment! Mishra makes room and angles it down to short third  man, they take a risky run and Shukla picks it up and hurls it to Saha, Dilshan grounds his bat but he wasn't quick enough to make his ground before Saha whips off the bails
on the middle stump as Dilshan reaches for it but cant get the timing right as he fails to retain the strike
outside the off stump as Mishra steers but a poor fielding effort by Hussey allows them a single
on the off stump as Mishra pushes it to covers off the front foot
outside the off stump as Mishra looks to cut it but the bottom hand comes off the grip as it goes to point
leg cutter on the off stump as Dilshan drives it to covers to rotate the strike
outside off, pushes it firmly to covers for a single
pushes it to mid on off the front foot
left alone outside the off stump
pushes to covers
on the good length on the middle stump as Dilshan pushes it hard into the leg side and calls for a couple but a misfield by Butt gets them a boundary
on the off stump as he pushes it to point for a single
outside off, tries to steer it and misses
on the off stump as Dilshan pushes it to square leg. Straining his wrists there
ever so short outside the off stump as Dilshan narrowly manages to cut it past point for the third boundary in an over. Now it's official, there is a counter attack
outside off on a good length as Mishra forces it to covers for a single
on the off stump and cutting it in as Mishra gives it the respect it deserves by defending it
on the off stump, steered to third man to change ends
on the leg stump pushed to mid on for a single
fuller outside off, Dilshan pastes it to point boundary for another boundary and if he is around he is a danger to the Knight Riders
short and wide outside the off stump, begging to be hit as Dilshan dispatches it to point boundary
outside the off stump and on a good length as Mishra drives it to cover for a single

can u people hear it as Eden goes crazy at the fall of Dhawan's wicket. Dhawan was looking to deposit a good length ball over midwicket and misses as Dinda sends the off stump for a cartwheel and sends the crowd into a frenzy and the owner of the Knight Riders is ecstatic. Why not ?
half volley on the off stump which Dhawan drives straight back to the bowler who threatens to throw the stumps down. Nice aggro shown there
Dinda bowls it on the leg side which makes Howell stretch his hands to signify a wide
outside the off stump and on a good length as Dilshan drives it to long off to hand the strike back to Dhawan
outside the off stump as Dilshan steers it away to third man for a single off the last ball
this is bang on what you call a suffocating length, well known as three quarter length as Dhawan manages to push it to mid off for a single. Well managed shot that
good length right on the pads as Dilshan flicks it to midwicket off his pads for a single
outside the off stump and on a good length as Dhavan comes forward and drives it to deep extra cover for a single
on a good length on the off stump as Dhavan comes forward and drives to mid off
short of a good length delivery which Dhawan spots but cuts a touch too early as he gets a bottom edge back to the keeper
bangs it in short and he swivels and mistimes the pull to midwicket
cramps him for a bit of room as he shapes to cut, he ends up chopping it down towards point
slides on the pads this time and he whips it away easily towards long leg
keeps it full again, he leans forward and defends towards mid-off
fuller in length, he gets forward and defends
superb timing! Dinda gives him just a little bit of width, he moves across just a touch and bangs it along the turf, the ball shoots up and beats cover
ends the over with a full delivery outside off, Dilshan leans forward and bashes it past cover, every run will be cheered by Delhi here
gets it to angle into the right hander, he wisely lets it go
Dilshan faces the hat-trick ball, he gets a short one and the pull is mistimed to the on side
He's on a hat-trick! Delivers from wide of the crease, he gives it everything and gets it to angle in sharply into the right hander, it hits Tiwary in line of offstump and Asad Rauf raises the finger

That's three for the road! Shoaib bangs that in short, puts in the extra effort, de Villiers sizes up for the pull but the ball comes on really quick, he gets a thick top edge and Taibu takes the sitter at square leg
good stuff from Shoaib, he gets it to angle in and nip back in off a good length, he gets an edge onto his pads but Shoaib appeals
sees the length which is fractionally short and goes for the pull too early, as a result he mistimes it wide of mid-on
walks down the pitch to unsettle him, he pitches it short and he can only nudge it off the pads
sticks to the same line and length, he angles it down towards point this time
lands it on a good length outside off, he gets forward and pushes it towards cover
and another, he lands it on the pads again, this ball was a touch fuller, he gets across and whips it wide of midwicket, the timing was good enough
Dinda bangs it in short and it comes on fairly quickly to Tiwary, he gets in position for the pull early and creams it over square leg
angles this one into the right hander from wide of the crease, he covers the line well and pushes it firmly towards mid-off
the speed gun said he crossed 150, he waits on it at the crease and angles it down to third man

and he's in business again! He pitches it short and wide, delivers it from wide of the crease, Gambhir can't resist a slash over the infield without really moving his feet, Hussey leaps at backward point and takes it easily
fires that full and wide outside off, there was an opportunity for a boundary but he ended up driving straight to cover
continues bowling wide of the crease and pitches that on middle, not as pacy as some of his earlier deliveries, de Villiers taps it with soft hands towards cover and sets off
slides down the legside and de Villiers gets a faint nick off his gloves
Ishanth fires that full and wide outside off, he steps down the track early, adjusts quickly to the pace of the ball and square drives it past cover
shapes to cut on seeing the width and he chops it down wide of first slip, third man picks it up
lunges forward for the drive and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads, they scamper a single
lands on a fullish length wide outside off and Gambhir fails to make contact with an expansive drive
that was off like a bullet! Ishant pitches that close to the pads and Gambhir flicks it away in a flash and before you knew it the ball was already past the deep dquare leg rope
fires that on a good length outside off, he angles it down to third man

fires that on a good length and tucks him up, he stays back and tucks it softly towards Ganguly at cover, he gathers the ball and hits the stump at the non-strikers end and de Villiers just makes it, the other fielders celebrate but the third umpire adjudicates
jams it on the blockhole this time and digs it out safely to the on side

delivers that from wide of the crease again, this time he fires that on a good length on middle and he whips it wide of square leg, the throw to the keeper is high and he whips off the bails, third umpire has a look but Gambhir was safe
delivers that from slightly wide of the crease and gets it to angle in towards the right-hander, de Villiers pokes his bat out and gets beaten

he strikes immediately! He fires that in on a fullish length outside off, it swings away from the right hander very late and Sehwag gets caught on the drive without moving his feet, he gets a thick outside edge to Saha, Shoaib does the aeroplane celebration and man is he happy
gets aggressive and fires that in wide down leg, Sehwag misses the glance, Shoaib gave it everything
huge roar as Shoaib runs in hard, he lands it just outside the line of offstump at a good pace, Gambhir chops it down towards point
